shortDescription: Greece sold €500 million ($570.30 million)  of 26-weeks T-bills at a higher yield compared with the previous auction, its debt agency PDMA said on Wednesday.The yield came in at 2.58%, down from 2.34% in August.($1 = 0.8767 euros)

children: Greece sold €500 million ($570.30 million)  of 26-weeks T-bills at a higher yield compared with the previous auction, its debt agency PDMA said on Wednesday.
The yield came in at 2.58%, down from 2.34% in August.
